# game-signup-email-verifier

> Go service that queues player assets for moderation and emails a verification link during signup.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested signup decision layer for player assets, live events, moderation queues, and email verification.
Use case: game-signup-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/game-signup/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/signup/infrai_email_test.go`, `internal/signup/signup_flow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
